# SmartMount – WoW 3.3.5a (WotLK)

<video src="SmartMount – WoW 3.3.5a (WotLK).webm" width="600" controls></video>

One button. One macro. Always the right mount.

SmartMount picks a **random mount from your fastest tier** for where you are right now:

- **Swimming** → Sea Turtle / Riding Turtle (spell `30174`, `64731`) if you own one
- **Flyable area** → fastest flying mount (280% vs 310% aware)
- **Otherwise** → fastest ground mount

Click again while mounted to dismount. If you're in a vehicle, it exits the vehicle first.

Trigger it three ways:

1. Button on the Companions / Mounts tab
2. `/smartmount` (alias `/smount`)
3. Auto-created `SmartMount` macro (drag to your action bars)

## Compatibility

- **Client:** World of Warcraft 3.3.5a (Wrath of the Lich King)
- **Interface:** `30300`
- **Version:** 2.0
- No dependencies, no libraries.

## Installation

1. Download / `git clone` this repo.
2. Copy the `SmartMount` folder into:
   `World of Warcraft\Interface\AddOns\SmartMount\`
